structured_output.what_is_happening: This is an 11-minute-old Meteora pool (not on a launchpad) for a token named "america.gov" with the ticker AMERICA. In its first 11 minutes it went up about 1000%, to roughly $121k market cap, on $1.6M of volume. At least 9 other "america.gov" / AMERICA tokens appeared in the same hour. The leading one (pwfA…, about $1.07M market cap, $167k liquidity) was created about 63 minutes before this pair. So this token is a late copy riding the leader's narrative. The creator seeded about $70k of liquidity and 100% of the LP is unlocked. GMGN tags 100 wallets as bundlers, and bundler traders account for about 69% of top-trader share. GeckoTerminal shows 1679 unique buyers but only 87 unique sellers, and the 5-minute price is already -22% off the high.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN tags 100 bundler wallets, and bundler traders make up about 69% of top-trader share. Buys outnumber sells about 1679 to 87 by unique wallet, but transactions are 4877 buys to 2678 sells, so a small set of sellers made many sells. The creator seeded LP on Meteora outside any launchpad and kept it fully unlocked. The name is copied from the leading token.
